title: WoDX Storyteller
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the open world. Players travel and act on their own, each on their own time in the night, with dawn warnings and a limit on solo actions. The Storyteller follows every character on a tracker (where, at what hour, what they did and rolled, and what needs a look), keeps the spotlight even, calls characters together for scenes with their times lined up, sets beats that fire on a time, a place or a flag, and reads a report of what moved between sessions. Encounters, beats that call characters and results that change the world wait in the approval queue. What players do on the map (WoDX Interactables) goes into the log, and a beat can fire on a change on the map. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
